items.title: Christian Gonzalez signs historic extension with Patriots
items.desc: The Patriots and Christian Gonzalez agreed to a four-year, $135 million contract extension.
items.impact: Gonzalez becomes the highest-paid corner back in the NFL with a $135 million deal and $102 million guaranteed. He'll now have his sights set on defending Jaxon Smith-Njigba and the Seahawks offense in Wednesday's season opener.
